name: desktop_control
description: Inspect and operate native Windows apps through the cua-driver MCP (UI Automation first, screenshot fallback). Read-only inspection is T1; any action with side effects is T2 with an exact recap. Blocked apps (password managers, banking, security tools, system settings) are never driven. Remote use is refused. DISABLED by default: needs the cua-driver installed and the owner's explicit enable.
route: inspect or operate a native Windows app (not a website), e.g. read what a window shows, click or type in a desktop app
x_blocker: cua-driver (cua_driver_cli on PATH or CUA_DRIVER_TOKEN set); enabling requires the owner's explicit yes (T2)
